officialPoIntegration.title: G-SYS Official PO Integration
officialPoIntegration.subtitle: Separate from Demo Send - registers the Official PO No. with G-SYS.
officialPoIntegration.officialPoNoUnassignedNote: Please enter the Official PO No.
officialPoIntegration.requestDialogBody:
Checks consistency against G-SYS data.
This does NOT register anything in G-SYS or send any data.
officialPoIntegration.errorNotApproved: Only an APPROVED order can prepare G-SYS Integration.

importConfirmReason.NOT_YET_IMPORTED: G-SYS has not registered this Official PO yet. This is not an error - the Batch may simply not have run yet. You can check again later.
importConfirmReason.MISMATCH: G-SYS has registered this Official PO No., but its line items don't match the current Order.

officialPoIntegration.importConfirmedNote: Confirmed: G-SYS's registered content matches this Order.
officialPoIntegration.errorNotSubmitted: This Order has not been placed into the Import Folder yet.
officialPoIntegration.reissueDisabledHint: Reissue becomes available only after "Create Revision" is used (once the manufacturer's response is confirmed) and the revised order is re-approved.
officialPoIntegration.reissueDialogBody:
The current Official PO (this Revision) will become SUPERSEDED, and a new Revision's Official PO (PENDING) will be created. The old Revision is never deleted - it stays in the Revision History.
This action never actually registers or sends anything to G-SYS.
officialPoIntegration.reissueSuccess: Reissued the Official PO. Please confirm the PO Number and regenerate the Excel/PDF for the new Revision.
officialPoIntegration.errorReissueNotRequired: A reissue is not currently required.
officialPoIntegration.cancelDialogTitle: Request cancellation of the Official PO?
officialPoIntegration.cancelDialogBody:
This will raise a Cancel Request for this Official PO (the currently ACTIVE Revision). A reason is required.
This does NOT cancel it yet - it only becomes CANCELLED after an ADMIN approves it, which also triggers the Manufacturer cancellation notice.
This is a G-OPS-internal Workflow state change only - it never actually revokes anything registered in G-SYS.
officialPoIntegration.cancelRequestSuccess: Cancel Request raised. Waiting for ADMIN approval.
officialPoIntegration.errorCancelNotAllowed: This Official PO already has a pending or approved Cancel, or has been reissued.
officialPoIntegration.cancelApproveSuccess: Cancel approved. The Manufacturer cancellation notice was sent (or skipped if no Contact is registered).
officialPoIntegration.errorCancelApprovalNotAllowed: There is no pending Cancel Request to approve.
officialPoIntegration.cancelRequestedNote: This Official PO has a pending Cancel Request. Waiting for ADMIN approval
officialPoIntegration.cancelledNote: This Official PO has been cancelled

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.createButtonTooltip: Records the content of a Supplier inquiry for this Order in the Portal (no real mail is ever sent). Can be created at any time, regardless of whether Official G-SYS PO integration exists or Fulfillment data can be retrieved.
followUp.skuHelperText: Leave blank for an Order-level inquiry.
followUp.reorderDialogBody: Creates a new Order Draft for this Case's SKU. Quantity is never auto-decided (Legacy Recommended Qty is the initial value).
